scope: Sky, weather and ground effects on six generic host meshes; no demonstration asset optimizations
limitations: GPU and throughput samples were taken on e34257e, before the capture-latency accounting follow-up; sample counts, shaders and cadence are unchanged.
Most throughput windows contained background CPU activity. The fresh-page baseline was clean. These samples do not establish a precise speedup.
An earlier baseline after other QA measured 237 FPS; with the same fresh-page setup it measured about 174 FPS, matching the corrected native runs.
The synthetic GPU workload varied around its 8 ms target. This is resource stress, not hardware emulation.
The temporal comparison measures within-run periodicity, not pixel error between identical cloud layouts.
